initial.why: The Ferrante Schism of 1958 (bible Part III 4.3-4.5): they hold that the Sabatini stole the Racks and that they took it back.
The same quarrel from the Sabatini side: the diplomats resent the independents less, and think them rough.
The Vannucci Split of 1967: they split from the Pellegrinos and 'have not forgiven or been forgiven' (bible 4.4).
The Pellegrino side of the 1967 split.
A long, bitter, partly cooperative history with the Irish on the South Piers (bible 4.2).
The 1973 massacre of the independent strikers left a lasting hatred in Kerrytown (bible 4.2).
Used as muscle and disposable: they hate being treated that way (bible 5.4).
The Strip is Vannucci ground and customer ground for the combine; the arrangement is resented (bible 5.2).

sabatini.why: Bible 4.1: the 'diplomats'; 'they like business and avoid war'; the young think the family fat and slow.

pellegrino.why: Bible 4.2: 'the fist and the favor'; working-class, visible, the most street presence.

ferrante.why: Bible 4.3: born of a war, 'a surplus of gunmen who have to earn something', 'a habit of provoking, a temper for border disputes'.

vannucci.why: Bible 4.4: 'secretive, watchful, and quicker to violence than to talk'; 'harder in the way men fear'.

brigades.why: Bible 5.1: 'a different relation to violence': the family is the neighborhood, loyalties older, the cause real; 'not a single mind': some want blood for 1973, some the cause, some the quiet life. Mean at the middle, the widest spread.

combine.why: Bible 5.2 and 3524: the older bankers use violence sparingly and through intermediaries; the young faster and more publicly.

horsemen.why: Bible 5.4: outlaw bikers, used as muscle and disposable, resentful.

russians.why: Bible 5.3: extortion of their own community; prey on those with no reason to trust the police.

bolita.why: Bible 5.7: numbers men; a business run on trust and arrangement.

decavalcante.why: Elizabeth family [memory]: a smaller, steadier family with a long-lived boss.

genovesenj.why: The Genovese faction [memory]: the largest family's New Jersey arm, labor and loansharking.

lucchesenj.why: The Lucchese New Jersey crew [memory]: Newark-based, with rising younger men.

philadelphia.why: Angelo Bruno's family [memory]: known as the 'docile don', who held the peace and the fief; the family turned violent after him.

gambino.why: The Gambino presence [memory]: Carlo Gambino was a business-first boss who avoided open war.

huntsrow_fence.why: Bible 3 (fencing): 'The best fences are patient, polite, and rich.'

hijackers.why: Independent hijackers: armed, with a living made on freight.

hired_men.why: Professionals who work for hire without a Family (bible 5.7).

greek_merchants.why: Merchants with their own lines (bible 5.7): a business people.

gun_dealer.why: A weapons dealer sells to everyone and trusts few.
